title: HashiCorp Nomad variables
description: Configuration variables for HashiCorp Nomad cluster server and client agents

NOMAD_VERSION.description: Specific version of HashiCorp Nomad to install.

NOMAD_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install HashiCorp Nomad ('libscript_native' isolates binaries in LIBSCRIPT_HOME, 'system' uses OS packages).

NOMAD_HTTP_PORT.description: TCP port on which the Nomad HTTP API listens.

NOMAD_DATA_DIR.description: Filesystem directory path for Nomad Raft state and allocation sandboxes.

NOMAD_HOME.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for nomad (NOMAD_HOME).
